source_summary: Tall handscroll-style Chinese landscape with inscriptions and seals above and around the image; motifs are taken only from the painted landscape area and exclude calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture.

motifs.name: misty_peak_range
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant mountain range in the upper landscape: soft beige and blue-gray peaks, dotted dark vegetation along ridgelines, and faint diagonal slope lines emerging through mist.
must_preserve: dark dotted tree texture on ridges

motifs.name: middle_island_shoreline
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal mid-distance river islands and shoreline bands beneath the distant hills, including small groves, low banks, and thin waterline strokes.
must_preserve: pale wash transitions between water and land

motifs.name: left_pavilion_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the left-bank pavilion partially hidden among dense trees and willows, with its slanted roof, pale walls, surrounding shrubs, rocks, and drooping branches.
must_preserve: layered shrub dots around the building

motifs.name: right_willow_bridge_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the right midground bank with the large leaning willow, sparse drooping foliage, low bridge or walkway strokes, and pale shoreline beside open water.
must_preserve: thin horizontal bridge or walkway strokes
small shrub accents at the base

motifs.name: central_blue_leaf_tree_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central cluster of river trees with pale trunks, blue-green leaf masses, bare interlaced branches, and low grasses at the roots.
must_preserve: pale bark wash with darker knots
root and grass texture at base

motifs.name: small_sampan_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the small flat sampan carrying a seated scholar figure and a few upright objects, floating on the river just left of the central trees.
must_preserve: small dark cargo or post shapes

motifs.name: right_slender_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the tall slender tree on the right edge with a high sparse canopy, pale trunk, branching fork structure, and nearby low shrubs; exclude adjacent red seals.

motifs.name: foreground_reed_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the low foreground shoreline with grasses, small shrubs, exposed rocks, pale sandbar wash, and horizontal water strokes across the bottom landscape.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
